mapper.select: SELECT f."FACILITY_ID" as facilityId, f."FACILITY_NAME" as facilityName, f."FACILITY_TYPE" as facilityType, f."ADDRESS" as address, CASE WHEN f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL THEN ST_AsText(f."GEOM") ELSE NULL END as geom, COALESCE(d."SEVERITY",3) as severity FROM facility f LEFT OUTER JOIN damage d ON f."FACILITY_ID" = d."FACILITY_ID" WHERE f."REGION" LIKE '%마포구%' AND f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."FACILITY_ID" ASC

SELECT f."FACILITY_ID" as facilityId, f."FACILITY_NAME" as facilityName, f."FACILITY_TYPE" as facilityType, f."ADDRESS" as address, CASE WHEN f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL THEN ST_AsText(f."GEOM") ELSE NULL END as geom, COALESCE(d."SEVERITY",3) as severity FROM facility f LEFT OUTER JOIN damage d ON f."FACILITY_ID" = d."FACILITY_ID" WHERE f."REGION" LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' AND f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."FACILITY_ID" ASC

SELECT f."FACILITY_ID" as facilityId, f."FACILITY_NAME" as facilityName, f."FACILITY_TYPE" as facilityType, f."ADDRESS" as address, CASE WHEN f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL THEN ST_AsText(f."GEOM") ELSE NULL END as geom, COALESCE(d."SEVERITY",3) as severity FROM facility f LEFT OUTER JOIN damage d ON f."FACILITY_ID" = d."FACILITY_ID" WHERE f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL AND ST_Y(f."GEOM") BETWEEN 33 AND 39 -- 한국 위도 범위 AND ST_X(f."GEOM") BETWEEN 124 AND 132 -- 한국 경도 범위 ORDER BY f."FACILITY_ID" ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility f WHERE f."REGION" LIKE '%마포구%' AND f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility f WHERE f."REGION" LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' AND f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL

SELECT f."FACILITY_ID" as facilityId, f."FACILITY_NAME" as facilityName, f."FACILITY_TYPE" as facilityType, f."ADDRESS" as address, CASE WHEN f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL THEN ST_AsText(f."GEOM") ELSE NULL END as geom, COALESCE(d."SEVERITY",3) as severity FROM facility f LEFT OUTER JOIN damage d ON f."FACILITY_ID" = d."FACILITY_ID" WHERE f."REGION" LIKE '%마포구%' AND f."FACILITY_TYPE" = #{facilityType} AND f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."FACILITY_ID" ASC

SELECT f."FACILITY_ID" as facilityId, f."FACILITY_NAME" as facilityName, f."FACILITY_TYPE" as facilityType, f."ADDRESS" as address, CASE WHEN f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL THEN ST_AsText(f."GEOM") ELSE NULL END as geom, COALESCE(d."SEVERITY",3) as severity, ST_Distance( f."GEOM", ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLng}, #{centerLat}), 5186) ) as distance FROM facility f LEFT OUTER JOIN damage d ON f."FACILITY_ID" = d."FACILITY_ID" WHERE f."GEOM" IS NOT NULL AND ST_Distance( f."GEOM", ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLng}, #{centerLat}), 5186) ) <= #{radiusMeters} ORDER BY distance
